page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no margin notes. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. Catchword at the bottom right, gathering signature at the bottom left.

main_text.p: vestribus adferat. In hac rerum constitutione, non est obscurum, quae Dei Omnipotentis voluntas sit: Pater enim Filij sui regnum collabi, majestatis suae gloriam conspurcari, ita tolerat, ut restaurationem flagitet, primo quoque die remedium adhiberi velit. Plane enim in profanissima hac tyrannide, solida Christi autoritas proculcata est, verus Dei cultus attritus, dū verbis religiosis, factis religionem destruunt. Quoniam ergo pestilens hoc malum, corpus Christi indies magis magisque depascens, tandem se nihil sani relicturum minatur (quum desperata cura, in potionatis hoc meretricio calice videatur) ex altera parte damnum reparemus. Resistamus hic bestiae, ne altius pedem in Christi hereditate figat, extraneos vero larguentes[?] quos ne pestilens etiam Antichristi anhelitus inficiat metus est, ab antiquo Ethnicismi languore liberantes, antidoto Evangelij adversus hanc contagionem muniamus. Sic labascentem in Europa verum Christi cultum alijs in orbis partibus restauremus, & nauseabundis ingratum Dei panem, ad famelicos Indos transferamus: si Ionae praedicatio nihil potest aut Samariae aut Hie-rofolymis, Niniven petat, illa conver-

page.notes: Long s is transcribed as s throughout. Doubtful readings: "larguentes" (marked [?]); "relicturum" printed with a ct ligature, read as relicturum; "alijs" read with j as printed; "Hie-rofolymis" hyphen read as printed at the line end; "famelicos" joined without a visible hyphen. The catchword "tetur." completes the word "convertetur" on the next page. The gathering signature is "S".
